blocks.text: Setting up your sales pipeline in Notion

The core of your workflow is the database. Start by creating a board view to visualize your lead stages. Press ⌘ N to create a new page, then type /board and select Board view. Name your columns Prospecting, Contacted, Meeting Booked, and Closed.

Every lead needs a consistent template. Click the arrow next to the blue New button in your database. Select New template. Add fields for Email, Phone, Company, and Last Contact Date. Now, whenever you add a new lead, you just click your template to populate these fields instantly.
Why BDRs use Lazur on Mac

When you are deep in a Notion database, menus can feel dense. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur where a specific filter or property setting is located. Lazur draws a circle on your screen to show you the path. This keeps you focused on your sales goals rather than hunting for buttons.

You spend 11 hours a week on email. Use Notion as your drafting station. Create a page for your email templates. Use the /toggle command to hide older templates and keep your workspace clean. When you need to send a message, hold fn and dictate your draft directly into Notion. It is faster than typing and ensures your notes are accurate.

items: Use ⌘ P for quick navigation. It is the fastest way to switch between accounts or prospect pages.
Add a Table of Contents block to long prospect research pages so you can jump to specific meeting notes.
Use /callout to highlight important deal blockers or next steps at the top of your page.
Filter your database by status to see only the leads that need attention today.
Lock your database pages once you have finalized your lead entry to prevent accidental deletions.

blocks.text: Do not let your workspace get cluttered. Archive old leads every month. Use a separate database for closed deals to keep your active pipeline clear. If you find yourself clicking too many times to update a status, look into database properties. You can change a status from a board view by just dragging the card.

If you have a large list, use the Filter button at the top right of your database. You can filter by assignee, date, or status. If the menu gets confusing, ask Lazur to explain how to set up a multi-condition filter. It will guide you through the process one step at a time.

faq.question: Can I use Notion offline on my Mac?
faq.answer: Notion requires an internet connection to sync your data. You can view pages you have previously opened while offline, but editing is limited.

faq.question: Does Notion integrate with my CRM?
faq.answer: Notion does not have a native, one-click integration for all CRMs. Most teams use tools like Zapier or Make to connect their CRM data to Notion.

faq.question: How do I speed up my workflow in Notion?
faq.answer: Use keyboard shortcuts like ⌘ P for search and / to add blocks. Mastering these will cut down your mouse usage significantly.
